A savings of 20% on energy operating costs through no-cost, low-cost and investment energy
improvements can increase a unit's profits as much as onthidnt Energy use
According to the U.S. Department of Energy, small commercial buildings typically spend about
27% more per square foot in energy costs than larger buildings.
On average restaurants spend almost three times the national average for energy usage
Fast food restaurants in particular due to there small footprint, lot's of equipment and long
hours even a higher average per square foot.
